name: Kia
source:
A mysterious boy who snuck into Katsuragi Private Detective Office. He seems to be from southeast Asia, but he has no trouble communicating in Japanese. He’s targeted by multiple assassins and Marina will also act as his bodyguard.
[spoiler]His full name is Kia Flatte (キア・フラット), he's [url=/c4476]Siria[/url]'s brother and [url=/c36727]Katsuragi[/url]'s son[/spoiler]
